findings.summary: The claim the section is named for lost its explanation.

evidence.baseline: A retreat exists to let practitioners experience directly, not be told about but actually inhabit, the turned-on relationship with life the work calls Wholesome Eroticism, the constancy of Loving Presence, the steadiness of Coherent Resonance held in a room full of others doing the same. These are the internal technologies, and they are learned the way any technology is learned: by doing, in conditions arranged so that doing succeeds.
evidence.shipped: Retreats would emphasize practice over information. They may let participants encounter Wholesome Eroticism, Loving Presence, or Coherent Resonance in community.

findings.diagnosis: Learned the way any technology is learned, by doing, in conditions arranged so that doing succeeds is the section’s argument and the definition of what a retreat is for. Held in a room full of others doing the same is the condition. The shipped version names the three tenets and drops the account of why a room matters.

findings.summary: The paragraph on the cohort becoming a body was deleted.

evidence.baseline: And retreats do something the solitary year cannot: they make the cohort into a body. Those who began as fellow students return as something nearer to kin, having witnessed and been witnessed, having presenced genius in one another across days of shared practice. The bonds formed there are the raw material of community.
evidence.shipped: Retreats may deepen bonds within a cohort.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the risk of pressure to conform, which the shipped text then states.
findings.diagnosis: Sixty nine percent of the section went and this paragraph is most of it. Raw material of community is the hinge into Part X, which is entirely about holding a community. Having witnessed and been witnessed is also the only place the volume shows the reciprocity it has been describing since Part III. The conformity risk is real and is kept, after the paragraph rather than in place of it.

findings.summary: The workshop image and its minimal equipment claim were cut.

evidence.baseline: The retreat is the workshop of the internal, and community and a few days apart are the only equipment it requires.

findings.diagnosis: This is the payoff of the internal technology argument from Part III: the whole apparatus is other people and some time. Removing it leaves Part IX with no connection to the volume’s central economic claim.

debtImpact.note: The no promised state and no compulsory interpretation clause is kept, as is the conformity and privacy caution.

improvements.note: Conditions arranged so that doing succeeds is, read adversarially, a description of engineered peak experience plus a supplied meaning, which is the standard mechanics of high-control retreats.
